reviews.name: Damiano
reviews.text: QTR was able to diagnose the problem, recover lost data and do so when other companies engaged for the same service could not. His technical acumen and customer service were fantastic and very reassuring!

assemblyPackages.name: Option 1: Minimum Assembly — Fastest Option
assemblyPackages.description: Quickest and simplest physical assembly option to get your PC built as fast as possible. Basic cable management only; no detailed cable routing or post-assembly testing package.
assemblyPackages.shortSummary: Fastest option — physical build & basic cabling only (no testing package)
assemblyPackages.footnote: Fastest tier: component installation and necessary cabling only. No detailed cosmetic cable routing or post-assembly testing package.
includes: Install all selected components into the PC case
Connect the necessary power and component cables
doesNotInclude: Detailed cable routing or cosmetic cable organisation
Post-assembly boot, component recognition, or stress testing package
Operating system setup, drivers, or FPS gaming benchmarks

assemblyPackages.name: Option 2: Medium Assembly — Complete Assembly (Balanced Option)
assemblyPackages.description: Complete balanced assembly option: organised cable management, proper functional cable routing, connection and cooling checks, basic post-assembly boot testing, and confirmation that main components are recognised.
assemblyPackages.shortSummary: Balanced complete assembly — organised cabling, connection checks & basic boot check
assemblyPackages.footnote: Balanced tier: properly assembled and verified booting with main hardware recognised (functional cable routing, not cosmetic showcase).
includes: Organised cable management & proper functional cable routing
Check component connections, fans & cooling connections
Confirm main components (CPU, RAM, GPU, storage) are recognised
doesNotInclude: Temperature, extended stress, or crash stability testing
Multi-game FPS benchmark suite (Payday 2, Fortnite, RDR2)

assemblyPackages.name: Option 3: Full Assembly & Testing — Premium
assemblyPackages.description: Highest-quality premium option: carefully routed and hidden cables with clean professional internal presentation, full boot and component recognition checks, temperature checks, stress and crash stability testing, plus measured real-game FPS testing.
assemblyPackages.shortSummary: Premium tier — showcase hidden cabling, thermal/stress stability & real-game FPS tests
assemblyPackages.footnote: Premium tier: clean hidden cable routing, full 9-point QA/stress checks, and authentic FPS benchmarks (never invented).
includes: Carefully routed & hidden cables for clean professional internal presentation
Full boot & complete component recognition checks
Temperature checks, stress testing, and crash/stability checks
Gaming performance testing: Payday 2 (Low), Fortnite (Medium), Red Dead Redemption 2 (Maximum) — actual measured avg/min/max FPS only
doesNotInclude: Additional paid software licences beyond components selected in your build
